title: Shaped SAEs: Expanding the Toolkit for Mechanistic Interpretability
abstract: arXiv:2610.27375v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) seek to decompose the dense activations of large language models (LLMs) into sparse, potentially interpretable features using a learned overcomplete dictionary. In this work, we ask whether it is possible to enhance the semantic selectivity of the learned dictionary atoms by linearly \emph{shaping} the dense activations prior to learning an SAE. We explore rank-reducing transformations based on the recently introduced J-space corresponding to the averaged Jacobian from the current layer to the LLM output, projecting activations onto the ``live'' subspace spanned by eigenmodes of the Jacobian with larger singular values (which we expect to be more semantically relevant). We also introduce a new approach for training SAEs in which (a)~an affine shaping transformation is learned along with the dictionary atoms, (b)~the atom selection mechanism is based on the TopK projections along the one-dimensional subspace spa

translated_title: 成形稀疏自编码器：扩展机制可解释性的工具箱
translated_abstract: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）旨在使用学习到的过完备字典，将大型语言模型（LLM）的稠密激活分解为稀疏且可能可解释的特征。在本工作中，我们探究是否可以在学习SAE之前对稠密激活进行线性“成形”，以增强所学字典原子的语义选择性。我们探索了基于最近提出的J空间的降秩变换，该空间对应于从当前层到LLM输出的平均雅可比矩阵，将激活投影到由具有较大奇异值的雅可比特征模所张成的“活跃”子空间上（我们期望这些特征模与语义更相关）。我们还引入了一种新的SAE训练方法，其中 仿射成形变换与字典原子一同学习， 原子选择机制基于沿一维子空间的TopK投影……
tldr: 本文提出通过在学习稀疏自编码器之前对语言模型的稠密激活进行线性“成形”变换（包括基于雅可比空间的降秩投影和与字典联合学习的仿射变换），来增强所学字典特征的语义选择性，从而扩展机制可解释性的方法工具箱。
